comments.text: It's hard to believe that places like these actually exist on our planet. Lake Natron being so hostile to most animals yet serving as a breeding ground for millions of flamingos is fascinating. And the Atacama Desert having areas that have gone without measurable rainfall for so long is just unbelievable. There’s so much about Earth's geography that most of us never hear about. Great video
